storage.description: A systematic approach to verify that data, systems, or processes adhere to defined rules, constraints, and logical relationships, ensuring absence of contradictions and maintaining integrity across states and over time.
storage.name: Consistency Checking
principles: Define explicit consistency rules and constraints
Automate validation at ingestion, transformation, and access points
Enable continuous monitoring and drift detection
Support reconciliation and conflict resolution workflows
Maintain audit trails for traceability and compliance
